findings.description: The dancer's left arm (screen-left side of the image) is raised fully extended overhead while her right arm hangs at her side. In the same frame, her mirror reflection shows the incompatible opposite state: the screen-right arm of the reflection is the one raised, bent at the elbow with the hand at head level, while the reflection's screen-left arm hangs down. A true mirror must show the raised left arm on the same side of the reflection; the reflection also differs in elbow bend (straight/extended vs. bent). The mirror behaves correctly elsewhere (e.g., at 00:02 the raised right arm appears on the matching screen-right side in the reflection), so this frame depicts a physically impossible reflection rather than a lens or angle artifact.
